notes:
I wasn't able to do any research on Daniel 5, so I have no notes for you yet.

My first attempt to open the pages (Enduring Word; Ellicott, Gill and the Pulpit Commentary on Bible Hub; and Precept Austin) was blocked before anything loaded. The tool said I had no more lookups available this turn. My other tools can't reach the internet, so I couldn't try another way.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say, give a URL for every point, and never fill gaps from my own knowledge. Writing notes now would break those rules, so I've written nothing.

If you start a new request, this is what I'll do:

1. **The traditional reading, verse by verse:** Enduring Word on Daniel 5, then Ellicott, Gill and the Pulpit Commentary on Bible Hub or StudyLight, then Precept Austin. I'll pull out notes for each of vv. 1–31.
2. **Where Protestant traditions differ:** search the Reformed, Baptist, Wesleyan, Pentecostal and Lutheran sites for Daniel 5 topics. These include Belshazzar, the writing on the wall and "weighed and found wanting." I'll only note real disagreements that their own teachers state.
3. **Other views:**
   - **Modern scholarship:** Bible Odyssey and the NET Bible notes, especially on who Belshazzar was, Nebuchadnezzar being called his "father," Darius the Mede, and what MENE, TEKEL, PARSIN means.
   - **Catholic and Orthodox:** New Advent (Church Fathers, Catholic Encyclopedia), Catholic.com and OCA.org.
   - **Debated popular teaching:** prosperity, word of faith or hyper-grace, only if the sites discuss this chapter.

Each point will be written in my own words and followed by its URL, and anything I can't find will be left out.
